description: AI-native low-poly workbench for consistent modeling, texturing, and animation.

workflow.instruction: Create a project with domActions and domFields, or ask the user to choose a file through openProject. Choosing no file starts no operation and must never enter running; never claim to inject a file.
Inspect again, require a valid target with no blocking finding, and review the viewport, Activity receipt, and Undo.

Use saveProject for .ashfox; for a target file use openExport, set domFields, then submitExport; for GIF use openCapture then startCapture. Wait for file phase succeeded with the same operation ID; no artifact downloads automatically.

steps: Reject paths outside the active workspace.
Activate the persistent artifact anchor, then transfer the download directly into the requested directory; never rely on auto-download and never copy its bytes through model context.
Verify the file exists, then report only its actual workspace-relative path and format.
delivery.fallback: If the host cannot download, write, or verify the file, report the last completed boundary exactly; never claim a workspace save.

rules: Inspect before authoring and use the returned current revision.
Inspect each command schema before filling its payload.
Set authored or emissive pixel art to atlasMode preserve. Omitted modes are preserved; only explicit generate modes enter UV generation.
Submit related operations as one atomic batch.
Retry a stale revision only after inspecting again.
All project changes must use run; the port delegates to the canonical reducer.
If pageApi is unavailable, send the same inspect or run request through domBridge.
A started file operation is complete only at a terminal phase with the same operation ID.
